## Purpose

Contribute a first finite-resolution non-tilted LRS Bianchi I Sigma/Pi pilot to rei_bianchi using existing pinned science code, while preserving completed HE29 reference4/canary1.

## Initial checkpoint

- Seven relevant repositories: 1,214 accessible branch refs inventoried, with selected actual source/result readback; this is not every file of every branch.
- New BASS S12 and REC U4B raw returns found. Completed lanes are reused.
- Personal-context access is unavailable; Drive and unpublished-host observation gaps remain explicit.
- Frozen Frobenius norm/SI/sign/source contract for C15 saved512 rows and a new28-case canonical pilot.
- Other Codex/science sessions are allowed under observed CPU/RAM capacity and shared leases; no blanket process-presence HOLD.

Intake/contract commit9479387545bc4ba29278f3990a83ca20ed2f2a73: actual content and Git blob readback13/13 PASS. New code/results are undergoing the one independent scoped review and will be added here. Detailed benchmarks excluded by owner. PR78 and PR81 remain Draft/open/unmerged; no merge is requested.

Scientific scope: LRS/coaxial finite pilot. General triaxial, continuous spectrum, full EoR, Grackle equivalence, observational Bianchi/CMB, and NCP64 speedup remain HOLD.
